Name: Hay Recolor
Author: briarbrews
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod is very simple, it just tones down the colors of the hay. [/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I made this partially to practice making mods changing small sections of a tilesheet, and partially because a friend wanted something to tone down the hay and not mess with anything else in her save. [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Unzip the file and place it in your mods folder. 
Make sure you also have content patcher installed or this mod won't work.  [/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Tones down the color of the hay. [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Content patcher is required for this mod to work![/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch]BogWyytch[/url] for encouraging me to make mods and for helping me troubleshoot while I was creating this mod. 
Bog is one of my favorite mod authors ever and a wonderful friend, you should all check out her mods because they are the best!! [/color]

Manifest.Name: Hay Recolor
Manifest.Description: This will recolor the hay in your game and tone it down from that bright yellow.
